feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: For Ukraine's Kherson region, a short ceasefire meant a momentary return to normal life
entry.summary: In Kherson city, usually seething with Russian drones, friends met at cafes, families were out together and shoppers stocked up. "The city seems alive," said one resident, "just like it used to be."

entry.title: Indian navy rescues 20 crew from Iranian fishing boat hijacked off Somalia
entry.summary: he operation involved a warship, a maritime surveillance aircraft and marine commandos. The hijacking followed a resurgence of Somali piracy across the Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean.

entry.title: Control of Congress is at stake today. And, judge to consider motion in Clancy case
entry.summary: Election Day is here, and voters are heading to the polls in an election that may change control of Congress. And, a judge is considering whether to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case.

entry.title: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing
entry.summary: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.

entry.title: Four types of House races to watch on election night to know how it might go
entry.summary: As polls close on Election Day and results start rolling in, these are some of the House races that will help explain how the midterms are unfolding.

entry.title: A new cold war: hackers target fridges across the globe
entry.summary: NPR investigated cyberattacks on the digital devices that control industrial refrigerators, revealing the extent to which operational technology is exposed to damage and disruption.

entry.title: It's Election Day. Control of Congress is on the line, and what else you need to know
entry.summary: There are a lot of variables for how things will go today. Results will start to come in at 6 p.m. ET in Kentucky and Indiana, and then it will be off to the races.

entry.title: How NPR makes race calls in the 2026 election
entry.summary: Race calls are a critical part of election night and NPR partners with the Associated Press to make those calls. Here's how we do it.

entry.title: From 'model minority' to target, anti-Indian hate on the rise
entry.summary: A massacre allegedly targeting Hindu Americans was recently thwarted, but researchers say it helps to illustrate a growing and increasingly mainstream hate directed at South Asians in the U.S.

entry.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
entry.summary: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.
